$comment: SHA-256 checksums for python-build-standalone install_only tarballs. Source: https://github.com/indygreg/python-build-standalone/releases/<release>/SHA256SUMS. The downloader iterates `releases` in order and falls through to the next on 404 — indygreg has yanked releases historically, and a single hardcoded release leaves every new install broken until we cut a patch. Add a fallback by pasting another release block here. Every release lists exactly the triples of VOICE_RUNTIME_PLATFORMS in supported-platforms.ts.
